text: Regulations on Stipend Support Provision to the students of the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (as amended as of October 15, 2019) 1. General Provisions 1. These Regulations on stipend support provision to the students of the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter referred to as Regulations) specify types of stipends awarded to the students of the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter referred to as University). They describe the proce dure for awarding and paying stipends, and composition and authorities of the University Stipend Committee. Item 1 of Paragraph 2 has been amended in accordance with

and composition and authorities of the University Stipend Committee. Item 1 of Paragraph 2 has been amended in accordance with Decision of the Managing Council dated October 15, 2019 No.15.10.2019 2. (residency students); 2) stipend – monetary payment duly awarded and paid to students in order and amounts as established by these Regulations; 3) Nazarbayev University Stipend – stipend awarded to student who is holder of Nazarbayev University educational grant; 4) Stipend of the President of the RK – stipend established by the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan and awarded in accordance with legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan; 5) Stipend of the President of the University – stipend established by the University and awarded to bachelor and master students in accordance with section 5 of the Regulations; 6) Kamkor

by the University and awarded to bachelor and master students in accordance with section 5 of the Regulations; 6) Kamkor Stipend – stipend established by the University and awarded to bachelor and master students in accordance with section 6 of the Regulations; 7) Stipend Committee – a regular consultative body under the President of the University that executes functions in accordance with Regulations; 8) Semester – Fall, Spring or Summer Semester defined in accordance with University study programs, and in case of Doctor of Medicine Program – academic year of study. 3. Stipend Support Provision to Students 4. The purpose of stipend support provision to students is to stimulate research, teaching and learning activities of conscientious students of the University , to provide social (financial) support to students, as well as partial covering their expenses during their study. 5. The following types of stipends are established at the University: 1) the Nazarbayev University Stipend; 2) the Stipend of the President of the RK; 3)

are established at the University: 1) the Nazarbayev University Stipend; 2) the Stipend of the President of the RK; 3) the Stipend of the President of the University; 4) the Kamkor Stipend; 5) name and other stipends. 6. Each type of stipend is awarded and paid in accordance with procedures established by the Regulations. 7. A stipend may be awarded for 1 (one) semester unless otherwise is established by these Regulations. A stipend may be awarded to the same person more than once in accordance with procedures and conditions established by the Regulations. 8. Students receiving one type of stipend

more than once in accordance with procedures and conditions established by the Regulations. 8. Students receiving one type of stipend have the right to receive another type of stipend provided that they meet the criteria established by the Regulations for each type of stipend. The Nazarbayev University Stipend 12. The amount of the Nazarbayev University Stipend is determined by the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 14. The Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded in accordance with the decision of the President of the University, on the basis of a memo signed by the head of the Bursar’s Office. The list of students eligible for the stipend is provided by the Office of the Registrar. 15. The Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded within 10 (ten) business days

The Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded within 10 (ten) business days from the first day of the academic semester (including Summer Semester), excluding the cases indicated in clause 21 of the Regulations. 16. The Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded to NUFYP students and doctoral students for the whole period of study and is paid on a monthly basis. 17. During the first semester of study t he Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded to bachelor and master students unconditionally and is paid on a monthly basis. 18. In the following semesters, the

awarded to bachelor and master students unconditionally and is paid on a monthly basis. 18. In the following semesters, the Nazarbayev University Stipend is awarded to bachelor and master students by the results of the examination session in accordance with criteria for awarding and paying the Nazarbayev University Stipend presented in the Appendix to the Regulations, and is paid monthly. Paragraph 19 has been amended in accordance with Decision of the Managing Council dated May 15, 2018 No.15.05.2018 19. Bachelor and master students who received the grade of “I” (“Incomplete”) based on the results of examination session for viable reasons

and master students who received the grade of “I” (“Incomplete”) based on the results of examination session for viable reasons (sickness, family issues, natural disasters and other circumstances related to the educational process outside of student’s control), and who provide appropriate documentation, are eligible for the Nazarbayev University Stipend payments. These payments will be made in accordance with procedures established in these Regulations, and will be awarded and paid after the student’s course requirements have been completed as per University’s internal regulations, for the period starting from the beginning of the semester during which Nazarbayev University Stipend is due for

internal regulations, for the period starting from the beginning of the semester during which Nazarbayev University Stipend is due for payment. Students who got the “I” (“Incomplete”) based on semester results for other reasons, will be awarded and paid Nazarbayev University Stipend in accordance with procedures established in these Regulations, next month after changing the score. 20. The Nazarbayev University Stipend is paid to students who are on maternity leave of absence at pre-leave rate (before leave of absence) for the period of the maternity leave of absence. The Nazarbayev University Stipend is not paid during child-care leave. 31. The Nazarbayev University S tipend is awarded and paid to bachelor and master students upon their return from leave

The Nazarbayev University S tipend is awarded and paid to bachelor and master students upon their return from leave of absence in accordance with the procedures established by these Regulations by the results of the last examination session, after which the leave of absence was taken. 4. The Stipend of the President of the RK 32. The Stipend of the President of the RK is awarded for 1 (one) semester to bachelor students starting from 3rd year and to 2nd year master students with “excellent” grades (A, A-), who study either on the basis of the Nazarbayev University educational

2nd year master students with “excellent” grades (A, A-), who study either on the basis of the Nazarbayev University educational grant or on a paid basis. The Stipend of the President of the RK is paid out of the republican budget funds in the amount and manner established by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 33. The Stipend of the President of the RK is awarded by the decision of the President of the University, on the basis of the Stipend Committee recommendations and approval of the Academic Council of the University. of the University 34. The Stipend of the President of the University is awarded to bachelor and master students out of the University budget funds on the basis of the recommendations of the Dean of the School. 35. The Stipend of the President of the University is awarded for not more than 1 (one) academic year. 36. Candidates for receiving Stipend of the President of the University shall demonstrate academic and research excellence in team work. 37. The University Stipend Committee determines and recommends the amount of the Stipend of the President of the University as well as its period of awarding on a basis of recommendations of the Dean of the School. 6. The Kamkor Stipend 38. The Kamkor Stipend is awarded to bachelor and master students out of the University budget funds . The amount and period are defined by the President of the University on the basis of the Stipend Committee recommendations.

The amount and period are defined by the President of the University on the basis of the Stipend Committee recommendations. 39. The Kamkor Stipend is awarded for not more than 1 (one) semester. 40. The University Stipend Committee 46. The primary goal of the Stipend Committee is to consider the issues related to stipend support provision to students in accordance

primary goal of the Stipend Committee is to consider the issues related to stipend support provision to students in accordance with the Regulations. 47. In accordance with its primary goal , the Stipend Committee executes the following functions: 1) determines and recommends amounts of the Stipend of the President of the University and the Kamkor Stipend within the University budget funds as well as their periods of awarding; 2) considers the issues on awarding name and other stipends and makes recommendations to the President of the University on establishing such stipends; 3) considers the candidates for awarding the Stipend of

recommendations to the President of the University on establishing such stipends; 3) considers the candidates for awarding the Stipend of the President of the RK, the Stipend of the President of the University and the Kamkor Stipend; 4) upon consideration of candidates, recommends students for awarding the following stipends: the Stipend of the President of the RK; the Kamkor Stipend; name and other stipends. 48. Scheduled meetings of the Stipend Committee shall be held not less than once every six months. Unscheduled meetings of the Stipend Committee shall be convened as required. The Decision on carrying out the meeting in absentia shall be made by th e Chairperson or by the Deputy Chairperson in case of his absence. 49. The meeting of the Stipend Committee is quorate if not less than half of all members are present at the meeting. 50. The decisions

Stipend Committee is quorate if not less than half of all members are present at the meeting. 50. The decisions on the issues, which fall under the jurisdiction of the Stipend Committee, shall be made by open balloting and by a simple majority of votes. In case of a tie vote, the vote of the Chair of the Stipend Committee shall be decisive. In case of tie vote, the decision took by the Chairperson of the Stipend Support Committee shall prevail. 51. The meetings of the Stipend Committee shall be documented in minutes, on the basis of which the President shall make a decision on awarding stipends to students of the University. 52. make a decision on awarding stipends to students of the University. 52. Stipend Committee shall be established by the decision of the President of the University. President of the University determines the personal membership of the Stipend Committee, which includes representatives from: 1) The Managing Council; 2) The Academic Council (Schools representatives); 3) The Faculty Senate; 4) The Department of Economic Planning and Analysis; 5) The Department of Student Affairs; 6) The Bursar’s Office; 7) The Office of the Registrar; 8) The Student Government (undergraduate and graduate representatives); 9) The Legal Department. 53. The Chair of the Stipend Committee shall be entitled to: 1) arrange the work of the Stipend Committee; 2) convene and chair the meetings of the Stipend Committee; 3) ensure compliance with the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the University internal regulations when considering issues related to award ing and paying stipends. 55. The Secretary of the Stipend Committee shall: 1) inform the members about convening of the Stipend Committee; 2) prepare documents for the meeting, formulate agenda, keep the minutes of the meetings; 3) prepare extracts from the minutes; 4) perform the recordkeeping of the Stipend Committee documents and transfer them in the University storage for keeping in accordance with the established procedures.
